title: Hull plating

hazard.text: Burned through: a hiss of air

down: Nothing yet; one more hit makes a hole (hull-repair 2)

guide.mistake: Welding too slow: it burns through, 2 HP

knobs._note: Design 1a: the good weld band (heat 0-1) is 0.35-0.85 at level 1, 0.015 off each end a level; the burn-through comes after 0.3 s over it, 0.015 s sooner a level.

_min_round_note: Provisional (design 8): 40% of the scripted hand's fastest round at each level, over every state and four seeds, until people's play is measured.
